text:
alex_sales: Hey team — Celestial sent over a 35-page vendor security questionnaire (CAIQ + custom). Need intake + owner. Attaching doc: https://redwooddocs.s3/celestial_qs_v1.pdf

marta_salesops: Thanks. Any critical callouts?

alex_sales: They flagged data residency (EU only), SOC2, and key management. Also want encryption at rest + in transit and incident notification SLA.

jin_security: I'm free to triage this afternoon. Can someone drop the CAIQ CSV? :mag:

alex_sales: Uploaded quick export to drive: https://drive.redwood/celestial/caiq_export.csv

security_bot: New intake created: SEC-2026-0423 assigned to jin_security. Deadline 2026-03-30 17:00 UTC.

jin_security: I'll start mapping questions to our controls and flag any gaps. Will need input from eng (ben_engineer) on KMS/rotation details.

ben_engineer: I can pull KMS key rotation policy and HSM details by EOD. Also note we have private deploy option for EU regions.

marta_salesops: Can we add a row to the sales tracker with estimated turnaround? I put provisional 5 business days.

alex_sales: Customer asked for a draft by Wed EOD. If security needs more time, I'll push expectations.

jin_security: Plan: 1) initial mapping (today), 2) draft answers + evidence (tomorrow), 3) review with eng (tomorrow PM), 4) finalize (Wed morning). Will update tracker.

alex_sales: Awesome. Please @marta_salesops when you mark items as 'needs evidence'.

jin_security: Will do. If any questions come up ping me directly or drop them in this thread. :+1:

security_bot: SEC-2026-0423 status updated to 'in progress' (jin_security).

alex_sales: Thanks all — marking POC hold until we confirm KMS posture.

ben_engineer: Quick note — we do not store customer PII by default, but we can sign DPA and SSO SAML support is available.

jin_security: Noted. I'll include DPA and SAML evidence links in the response doc.

marta_salesops: Updated tracker with KMS expected ETA and assigned follow-ups. Link: https://airtable.redwood/sales/celestial

alex_sales: Wrapping up — I'll set calendar for review tomorrow 16:00 UTC. Invite sent.

ben_engineer: Got it.

jin_security: Thanks — will have first draft in that meeting.
